fields.name: applicationName
fields.description: Display name shown in the UI (MailCraft, IAM, etc.).

fields.name: url
fields.description: Application URL — must be http(s); validated in the form layer.

fields.name: credentialId
fields.description: Optional Secret.ItemId used to log into the target during verification.

fields.name: enabled
fields.description: true | false. Stored as a string because Blocks Data schema fields are primitives — the adapter coerces to boolean.

fields.name: lastVerifiedAt
fields.description: ISO timestamp of the last completed verification run on this target.

fields.name: lastStatus
fields.description: TargetStatus of the most recent run (healthy / issues_found / verification_failed / …).
